allowedDaemonOriginsMode.title: Daemon origin mode
allowedDaemonOriginsMode.description: Discover daemon origins automatically from a trusted daemon, or use the explicit list.

allowedDaemonOrigins.title: Allowed browser daemon origins
allowedDaemonOrigins.description: Exact HTTPS origins this extension may pair or reconnect with; an empty list denies all daemons.

daemonDiscoveryOrigin.title: Daemon discovery origin
daemonDiscoveryOrigin.description: Trusted HTTPS daemon that supplies the automatic origin list.

defaultName.title: Default browser name
defaultName.description: The name this browser gets when it pairs without one being entered, e.g. laptop-chromium.
